Residents:

Bathroom: detergent, laundry basket, Felix razor, skincare, toiletry bag (shelf); Aisha razor (sink); Aisha meds (cabinet); soap, toothbrushes (sink); towels (rack).

- Blanket moves couch -> coffee table -> couch (21:00-23:00).

Aisha takes tablet, phone, backpack, jacket, keys, wallet, shoes, water bottle, lunchbox, notebook, pen, headphones. Items are "not in any room" (carried out) until 18:00 return.
